$comment: The field controls a step type definition can use: the Step Type Builder's palette. Each control lists the field properties it reads and the features an author can switch off. A definition's field names one control in `control`. js/step-types/02-definitions.js checks fields against this file (validate with `palette`), and ATLAS renders only controls whose status is `available` in the engine it runs. Feature defaults are `true`; a definition switches one off with `features: { name: false }`, which hides it for new steps only.

commonProperties.name: param
commonProperties.description: The step parameter the control reads and writes. Never renamed once steps use it.

commonProperties.name: help
commonProperties.description: Hint shown under the control and linked to it with aria-describedby.

commonProperties.name: helpId
commonProperties.description: Id of the help text, for markup that names it. Defaults to atlas-<param>-hint.

commonProperties.name: required
commonProperties.description: Marks the control required and reports a blank value as an Audit Issue.

commonProperties.name: requiredIssue
commonProperties.description: false keeps the required mark but leaves the Audit Issue to the type's own checks.

commonProperties.name: default
commonProperties.description: Value written to a new or blank step.

commonProperties.name: visibleWhen
commonProperties.description: Shows the control only when the condition holds. The editor redraws when a parameter the condition reads changes.

commonProperties.name: enabledWhen
commonProperties.description: Disables the control unless the condition holds.

commonProperties.name: layout
commonProperties.description: full spans the whole editor row.

commonProperties.name: group
commonProperties.description: Groups related fields in the builder.

controls.name: source_picker
controls.label: Source picker
controls.description: Chooses one of the audit's source files.

controls.name: field_picker
controls.label: Field picker
controls.description: Chooses a field of a source, or any field and created column when no source is linked.

controls.name: choice
controls.label: Choice
controls.description: One value from a fixed list, as cards, chips, a segmented control or a select. Each option can be hidden for new steps; a saved step that uses a hidden option still shows it.

controls.name: text
controls.label: Text
controls.description: One line of text, with optional suggestions.

controls.name: whole_number
controls.label: Whole number
controls.description: A whole number between optional limits.

controls.name: hidden
controls.label: Hidden value
controls.description: Keeps a parameter on the step without showing it.

controls.name: hint
controls.label: Hint
controls.description: A line of help text. Writes no parameter; param only names it.

controls.name: callout
controls.label: Callout
controls.description: A highlighted note built from a template, usually shown with visibleWhen. Writes no parameter; param only names it.

controls.name: block
controls.label: Editor block
controls.description: An editor named from the step type library (sort_keys, duplicate_keys). Kept for definitions written before these became controls.

controls.name: sort_keys
controls.label: Sort fields
controls.description: A list of sort fields, each with a direction. Stores sort_fields_json and mirrors the first field to source_file, field_name and sort_direction.

controls.name: duplicate_keys
controls.label: Duplicate key fields
controls.description: A list of fields that together identify a duplicate. Stores duplicate_fields_json and mirrors the first field to source_file and field_name.

controls.name: condition_group
controls.label: Conditions
controls.description: IF conditions joined with AND / OR, with nested groups. Stores the tree in conditions_json.

features.name: nesting
features.label: Nested groups
features.description: AND / OR groups inside the condition list.

features.name: fieldCompare
features.label: Compare with a field
features.description: Compare with another field, including one from a second source.

features.name: valueList
features.label: Value lists
features.description: Compare with several values at once.

features.name: runParameters
features.label: Run parameters
features.description: Compare with a run parameter such as the run date.

features.name: math
features.label: Calculated values
features.description: Compare with a calculation.

features.name: firstAvailable
features.label: First available value
features.description: Use the first field that has a value.

features.name: groupChecks
features.label: Group checks
features.description: Checks across the records of a group.

controls.name: action
controls.label: Action
controls.description: What a THEN or ELSE branch does. Stores then_action_type and the parameters of the chosen action.

features.name: display
features.label: Display
features.description: Display the records.

features.name: do_not_display
features.label: Do not display
features.description: Leave the records out.

features.name: display_text
features.label: Display text
features.description: Write a text response in a column.

features.name: set_column_value
features.label: Set value from a field
features.description: Copy a field into a column.

features.name: set_column_calculation
features.label: Calculation
features.description: Write a calculation into a column.

features.name: set_column_string_transform
features.label: String transformation
features.description: Write part of a text value into a column.

features.name: freeform
features.label: Freeform text
features.description: Describe the action in words.

controls.name: math
controls.label: Calculation
controls.description: A structured calculation of fields and numbers with optional rounding. Stores the expression as JSON in its param.

features.name: rounding
features.label: Rounding
features.description: Round the result to a number of places.

controls.name: string_transform
controls.label: String transformation
controls.description: Part of a text value: first or last characters, character count, or a split into columns.

features.name: first_characters
features.label: First characters
features.description: Keep the first N characters.

features.name: last_characters
features.label: Last characters
features.description: Keep the last N characters.

features.name: character_count
features.label: Character count
features.description: Count the characters.

features.name: split
features.label: Split into columns
features.description: Split on a delimiter into several columns.

controls.name: join_keys
controls.label: Join keys
controls.description: Pairs of fields that match records of two sources. Stores join_keys_json and mirrors the first pair to left_field and right_field.

features.name: multipleKeys
features.label: Several key pairs
features.description: Match on more than one pair of fields.
